propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE tells FAIL callers that concrete ticket-comment evidence will be considered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence
untagged external criteria are deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable by ADR 0043 and cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone
the second 8322 verifier failure was contractually correct rejection of untagged external evidence, not a recovery defect
remediation guidance must distinguish between repository-verifiable evidence and external operator-attested evidence with the exact tag named
existing interface test must be strengthened to require [operator-attested] tag assertion and untagged external criterion limitation
guidance must remain generic without advertising force/bypass and must not change completion-verdict semantics
